item.title: KATSEYE Coming to Theaters With ‘KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS’ Film Featuring Never-Before-Seen Footage, EYEKONS Fan Videos & Interviews
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Get ready, KATSEYE fans! The Grammy-nominated girl group is about to take over the big screen with their new film, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS. The movie hits theaters worldwide on August 12th, just two days before the release of their highly anticipated WILD EP."
[Short music transition]
Host: "WILD HEARTS promises to be a captivating journey into the group's bold new era, featuring never-before-seen footage, fan videos, and intimate interviews with the band members. It's being described as a 'love letter' to their devoted fan base, the EYEKONS, and explores the powerful bond between the group and their global fandom."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The film takes viewers on a journey from the group's formation on the reality TV competition series Dream Academy to their chart-topping global success. You'll get to see the highs, setbacks, sacrifices, and breakthrough moments that helped KATSEYE become one of pop's most exciting new global acts."
[Short music transition]
Host: "And if that's not enough, KATSEYE is also gearing up to release their third EP, WILD, on August 14th. They've already had a huge year with hits like 'Pinky Up' and 'Iconic By Mistake', and will be launching their Wildworld global arena tour on September 1st in Dublin, Ireland."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Don't miss out on the KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS cinematic event. Tickets go on sale July 15th, and you can get more information on the film and the tour at the link in our show notes. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
